01.speaker: A
01.text: Hi, I’m Nia. I usually work in the library, but this week I’m helping at the front desk.

01.speaker: B
01.text: Nice to meet you. Do you normally start at nine?

01.speaker: A
01.text: Yes, but today I’m starting at ten because the centre opens late.

01.speaker: B
01.text: Just today, then? I’ll meet you at ten by the main door.

02.speaker: A
02.text: I lost my wallet on Saturday. I think I left it at the station café.

02.speaker: B
02.text: What time did you buy your coffee?

02.speaker: A
02.text: At about one. I paid in cash and then I took the bus.

02.speaker: B
02.text: We found a blue wallet under a table. Can you describe yours?

03.speaker: A
03.text: I’m going to visit the book fair. Are you free on Friday?

03.speaker: B
03.text: I can’t do Friday. How about going on Saturday morning?

03.speaker: A
03.text: That works for me. I’m meeting Dani at the library at eleven.

03.speaker: B
03.text: Let’s meet outside the fair at half past eleven, then.

04.speaker: A
04.text: The two twenty to York is delayed by forty minutes.

04.speaker: B
04.text: Is there another train? I need to arrive before four.

04.speaker: A
04.text: Take the two thirty-five and change at Leeds. It leaves from platform six.

04.speaker: B
04.text: Can I use the same ticket?

05.speaker: A
05.text: I bought this jacket yesterday, but it’s too small.

05.speaker: B
05.text: Do you have the receipt? We can exchange it for a medium.

05.speaker: A
05.text: A medium would be great. Can I try it on first?

05.speaker: B
05.text: Of course. The fitting room is at the back.

06.speaker: A
06.text: Hello, I need to move my appointment. I can’t come on Monday.

06.speaker: B
06.text: I can offer Tuesday at eleven. Does that suit you?

06.speaker: A
06.text: Yes, thank you. Do I have to print the form?

06.speaker: B
06.text: No, but you have to bring your card.

07.speaker: A
07.text: We’d like two tomato salads and a bowl of rice, please.

07.speaker: B
07.text: Would you like anything to drink?

07.speaker: A
07.text: Two bottles of water. Can one salad be without cheese?

07.speaker: B
07.text: Of course. One salad without cheese and one with cheese.

08.speaker: A
08.text: How do I get to room seven from here?

08.speaker: B
08.text: Go past reception and take the lift to the second floor.

08.speaker: A
08.text: Is the room on the left when I come out?

08.speaker: B
08.text: Yes. It’s next to the stairs, opposite the small office.

09.speaker: A
09.text: Did you see the message about the Saturday workshop?

09.speaker: B
09.text: Yes. I’d like to join, but I can’t arrive before ten.

09.speaker: A
09.text: I’ll ask if you can join late. Can you bring some paper?

09.speaker: B
09.text: Yes. Could you send me the room number?

10.speaker: A
10.text: The class has moved from room four to room five.

10.speaker: B
10.text: Is it still at eleven? I can’t stay after one.

10.speaker: A
10.text: It starts at twelve now. You can use the side entrance.

10.speaker: B
10.text: OK, room five at twelve. I’ll message Ana.
